provenance: Independent synthetic release044 composition cases. No original utility or upstream source is copied or edited.

cases.name: late_degree_failure_pending_record
cases.note: Out-of-domain degree evaluation is an interpreter runtime guard; GNU is compile-only.

cases.name: invalid_format_before_loop_bounds
cases.note: Malformed runtime format must fail before undefined implied-DO bound evaluation; no unsafe GNU execution.

cases.name: late_deferred_length_failure
cases.note: Unallocated deferred CHARACTER length value is deliberately not executed by GNU.

cases.name: late_undefined_array_body
cases.diagnostic: read of uninitialized array element a
cases.note: Undefined second element has no portable GNU value; candidate must stage the first item without committing it.

cases.name: dynamic_empty_body_iteration_cap
cases.note: GNU has no matching interpreter iteration cap; compile-only.

cases.name: dynamic_value_cap
cases.note: GNU has no matching 65,536 expanded-value limit; compile-only.

cases.name: pending_record_limit_with_loop
cases.diagnostic: combined output record exceeds character limit
cases.note: The shared 65,536-character pending-record cap is interpreter policy, not a GNU limit.

cases.name: loop_step_budget_hint
cases.diagnostic: execution step limit exceeded (current limit: 200); use --max-steps N to set the execution budget (positive 64-bit integer)
cases.note: A deliberately small candidate work budget must produce CLI advice and no partial loop output; GNU has no equivalent limit.

cases.name: variable_zero_loop_step
cases.note: Zero implied-DO step is compiled, not executed, by the GNU oracle.

cases.name: reject_variable_advance_with_loop
cases.diagnostic: ADVANCE requires an explicit format and literal YES or NO
cases.note: GNU-valid variable ADVANCE remains outside the literal-only bounded contract.

cases.name: reject_len_assignment_with_loop
cases.diagnostic: Component selection requires a derived type

cases.name: reject_format_function_mutation
cases.diagnostic: Mutable module writes inside ordinary functions are unsupported
cases.note: Existing ordinary-function mutable-module restriction remains in force inside an output implied-DO.
